role: Base class of every GUI: the z level and the textured-rectangle, solid-rect, gradient-rect and string drawing helpers every screen and the HUD reuse.
scope_reason: The HUD and the container screens draw through these helpers; the native overlay implements the used subset.

members.name: zLevel
members.note: the native overlay is a painter's algorithm over the frame; no z level; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: drawRect
members.note: the native slot highlight (screen_highlight) writes pixels directly; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: drawGradientRect
members.note: the full-screen overlay gradient (screen_gradient) and the scaled-rect gradient cover the two uses the screens make

members.name: drawCenteredString
members.note: the native callers centre with font_width themselves; the shadowed draw matches

notes: Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): data structure or helper replaced by fixed arrays or inlined arithmetic (GPU contract), behavior covered by its callers. Formerly listed as missing: drawRect and the horizontal/vertical line helpers have no native counterpart (the slot highlight writes pixels directly in screen_highlight). drawTexturedModelRectFromIcon and the two static float-UV variants func_146110_a and func_152125_a are not drawn.
